instruction: Compile all .txt files from your vscode project into one LibreOffice Writer document "compiled.docx" on Desktop. Center-align the first paragraph and configure the font size to 14.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.getWindowsWithTitle('compiled.docx'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires merging 5 txt files into a docx, center-aligning the first paragraph, and setting font size to 14. Evaluator checks alignment and font size.

Correct weighting: Content compilation gets 50% of score, alignment 25%, font size 25%
Robust comparison logic: Uses whitespace-normalized comparison to handle formatting variations
Proper edge case handling: Handles missing files, empty content, zero paragraphs
Postconfig present: Saves docx file before evaluation to ensure fresh state
Minor deduction: Could be more explicit about minimum content threshold, but current logic is sound
